name: Zeroshot
description: Runs coding agents through a configurable graph of implementation, independent review and bounded repair, with parallel steps, reusable profiles, a local graph editor and SQLite run history.

skills.name: Run Agent Graph
skills.description: Execute a coding-agent graph with the run and plan commands, chaining implementation, review and repair steps with parallel execution.

skills.name: Reusable Profiles And Templates
skills.description: Define and reuse run configurations through the profile, template and target commands instead of rewriting graph setup per run.

skills.name: Run History And Resume
skills.description: Inspect past runs with logs, watch and status, and continue interrupted work from stored checkpoints using resume and attach.

skills.name: ACP Delegation
skills.description: Drive external coding agents over the Agent Client Protocol via the acp and delegation commands, including MCP setup for the agents it runs.
